method: Retained means numeric observations are downloadable and queryable here. Source identified means the publisher has relevant data, but this release has not ingested its rows. An identified source does not add records to the atlas's counts or maps.

sources.name: BC deposit glass and refillable dairy bottles
sources.value: Units sold and returned, estimated recovered glass weight, regional returns and described downstream uses; dairy return loop kept separate.
sources.gap: No receiving-facility name, shipment route, branch tonnages, jar origin or audited dairy figures.

sources.name: Power plant fuel receipts
sources.geography: United States, reported plants and coal supply regions
sources.value: Final 2025 EIA-923 monthly coal receipts joined by mine ID to MSHA mine coordinates and by plant ID to EIA-860 plant coordinates. 6,545 identified-mine receipt rows and 626 named mine–plant pairs are downloadable; the map features 189 plants.
sources.gap: The reported delivery does not disclose the physical rail alignment, intermediate stops, electricity customers or a parcel-level chain of custody. Coal generation is a separate plant measure; missing months are not estimated.

sources.name: Waste Data Interrogator
sources.value: Permitted-site waste received and removed by code; separate throughput ledgers.
sources.gap: Incoming and outgoing facility totals do not track the same consignment; hazardous scope and withheld identities require care. Rows not ingested.

sources.name: Côte d’Ivoire cocoa supply chains and cooperatives
sources.value: Cooperative, company, export and trade associations for a cocoa journey, with modeled disclosure where direct tracing is missing.
sources.gap: Relationships differ in confidence and scope; reuse terms need review before retaining full rows.

sources.name: Indonesia pulp supply chains and concessions
sources.value: Concessions and supply chain estimates can enrich the wood-to-paper map.
sources.gap: Modeled links are not observed log shipments; full rows and geographic layers not yet retained.

sources.name: World Settlement Footprint 3D material stocks
sources.value: Modeled stocks across 18 materials and five building types; useful for showing material still in buildings.
sources.gap: Stock is not annual production, site-specific composition or measured demolition waste; tiles not yet ingested.

sources.name: US mines, smelters, refineries and recycling facilities
sources.value: 800+ mapped sites covering 60 commodities and recovery operations; a potential upgrade for the facility layer.
sources.gap: Facility points do not establish throughput or supplier-buyer connections; rows not yet ingested.

sources.name: Global Cement and Concrete Tracker
sources.value: Operating cement and clinker capacity and operating plant counts by country; 171 country/area rows retained.
sources.gap: These country aggregates do not identify supplying quarries, actual 2025 production, plant coordinates or shipment routes. Existing Climate TRACE points remain a separate inventory.

sources.name: PRODCOM manufactured products
sources.value: National manufactured product volumes can connect raw-material accounts to finished goods at country scale.
sources.gap: Product totals do not identify supplying facilities, consumers or border routes; rows not yet ingested.

sources.name: Global capture and aquaculture production
sources.value: Food production history can add fish and aquaculture quantities to existing crop and forestry series.
sources.gap: Catch and production observations cannot be converted into a landed vessel route; rows not yet ingested.

sources.name: MINFILE mineral occurrences
sources.value: Mapped occurrences and mine attributes can enrich local geology and extraction context.
sources.gap: An occurrence is not necessarily a producing mine; live identifiers and status require review before joining to any route.

sources.name: Global Iron and Steel Tracker country summaries
sources.geography: 84 countries and areas with operating plant counts; 79 with capacity rows
sources.value: Operating crude steelmaking capacity by basic oxygen, electric arc and other methods, and tracked operating plant counts. Original thousand tonnes/year converted to million tonnes/year.
sources.gap: Plants generally must meet 500,000 tonnes/year threshold. Capacity is not output or trade; electricity source and recycled-feedstock share are not inferred.

sources.name: Mineral Commodity Summaries 2026 · world production
sources.value: 2025 country production estimates retained for copper mine and refinery, primary aluminium smelters, lithium mines and raw steel: 63 numeric country-by-process observations across five source series.
sources.gap: Only these four commodities and named country rows are ingested. US lithium production is withheld. Other countries is not assigned to any nation; no plant-level supplier or shipment is inferred.

sources.name: Global Coal Mine Tracker · August 2026
sources.value: Mine locations, status and production or capacity fields can extend named coal source coverage beyond the U.S. receipts map.
sources.gap: Tracker locations do not reveal a mine’s customers or physical transport path. Download terms and the record-level definitions must be checked before publishing rows.

sources.name: Statistical Review of World Energy 2026
sources.value: Recent oil, natural gas, coal and electricity production and use statistics could provide a common-year comparison across energy carriers.
sources.gap: Access and reuse conditions need review before retaining tables. National energy balance does not identify a shipment, port call or specific power plant.
